description: Search leads in the app the request is scoped to. Returns bounded named summaries and IDs, never full rows. Use get_lead to load full detail for a specific id. Default source is 'discovered' (agent-found, awaiting approval); pass source='approved' to search leads already in campaigns. Optional 'search' keyword runs an ILIKE across name/company/headline; optional 'status' narrows by lead status. If results are thin, surface the count and ASK the user before broadening the filters — do not silently relax constraints.

limit.description: Max number of leads to return (1..50)

search.description: Optional keyword (matches name, company, or headline)

name: find_leads
